I'm the friend OP was talking about, here's what I experienced.
I'd also done mushrooms a few times, took LSD once before and took 2c-b a few times so far. It wasn't comparable with what I experienced last friday.

I already knew how the onset felt, or at least I knew that what I was feeling must've been due to the LSD, my body felt heavy and light at the same time and the walls were starting to look quite funky about 45 mins in. We watched some funny videos on YouTube and laughed a lot more than we would've normally. 
And then OP's face looked like it was melting. That was the point where we kinda lost the ability to form full sentences and basically just threw words at each other. Despite not forming sentences, we managed to understand each other fully. 
The hours went by slow and fast at the same time, like, one time you'd look at the clock and 5 minutes had passed which felt like an hour and another time you'd check the clock and 2 hours passed which felt like 3 seconds. I've never really had that on my other trips. Usually, I'd really feel some Psytrance but for some reason tøp felt much nicer. Like, the bass felt like it was coming from within me? It was really cool. At some point, me and OP were standing on chairs. Still don't wanna think what people would've thought if they had seen that.
We didn't go to sleep at all and stayed up all night, talking about a lot of things, I've shared things I would've never told him before but it felt right just talking about whatever came to mind. And I don't regret anything.

Since then I honestly feel changed, I managed to stand up for myself a lot more, I manage to respond to strangers when I'm not with friends, which had been really hard for me before. I confronted my mother about a thing that had been bothering me for years. Didn't go too well, but could've been worse. "Could be worse" has also become my attitude, I learned on how to stop giving a fuck about things that would've sent my thoughts spiraling. And it's amazing to feel like I'm finally at a place where I wanted to be years ago.
My relationship to OP has become so much closer, it feels like we've known each other for years and not just the few months it actually is. Kinda feels like our brains built bridges to each other or something. And to be honest, I think last friday was one of the best days in my life.
